items.title: Identify the different cursor layers
items.scope: Distinguish the system pointer, helper overlays, app-painted pointers and text carets.
items.evidence: Actual native and Chrome footage showed residuals after capture-level pointer hiding.

items.title: Verify child-window and helper-exclusion controls
items.scope: Explicit options, filter-aware source identity and recording-tap routing on isolated candidates.
items.evidence: Native child inclusion/exclusion and filtered tap-versus-lane checks passed. Older engines refuse unsupported controls.

items.title: Detect excluded-helper changes and recover with a fresh take
items.scope: Owned background helper on the built-in display; observed process changes interrupt the recording.
items.evidence: Unrelated app launch/close kept the take running; helper termination preserved uncertain partial video; fresh-PID recovery passed. All 661 muxed timestamps matched.

items.title: Guard helper identity for persistent preview lanes
items.scope: Candidate preview identity lifecycle: observed helper changes invalidate affected buffers/lanes, absent helpers refuse, fresh requests resolve new identities; forced SDK/main-run-loop stalls remain unqualified.
items.evidence: Signed/loaded 83efb9156bea passed 15 mechanical checks, two targeted MCP tests, live affected-lane retirement with an unrelated lane retained, absent-helper refusal and fresh PID 48094 to 50261 recovery. Both owned engines exited and leases returned to zero. Off-Space helper adds no new pixel-exclusion proof; ninth-pass recording pixel evidence retained.

items.title: Capture native menus and child surfaces
items.scope: Owned AppKit fixture and the tested child-window modes.
items.evidence: Native menu pixels were present with child inclusion and absent without it; bounded source frames were inspected.

items.title: Complete the Chrome surface qualification lane
items.scope: Genuine native menus, HTML menus, native select controls and reachability.
items.evidence: Prior native/HTML proofs retained. New narrow fixture was capturable in isolated mode but covered in display mode despite on_screen true. Native coordinates refused noWindowsAvailable; browser expand/native key delivery did not establish a visible select popup. Application-filter probe returned SCK -3811. Owned tabs closed; unresolved readiness recorded and exactly read back from shared facts as unknown.
items.next: Repeat only the popup boundary on a verified reachable foreground Chrome surface. Do not infer native readiness from DOM actions, focus or on_screen metadata.

items.title: Verify three nested Electron menu levels
items.scope: Owned VS Code window in the tested child-inclusion modes.
items.evidence: Three levels were captured with child inclusion and absent without it; five takes matched 5,002 muxed timestamps.

items.title: Prove a useful overflow capture and recovery path
items.scope: Display padding/cropping must add transient coverage beyond the original canvas.
items.evidence: Two sequential native takes passed 102 exact timestamps. A 190×58 popup crop extends 140 points right/28 down beyond the original frame; its source map matched independent screenshot glyphs at zero offset (0.916 IoU). Retained evidence recheck passed. Display footage kept the popup but lost its base to occlusion.
items.next: Qualify multiple nested levels and synchronized base/overflow coverage before promising whole-shot recovery. The supplied crop is a proven layer; automatic segmentation and broader app lanes remain open.

items.title: Define reliable clean-source profiles across daily apps
items.scope: State which cursor-like layers can be removed for each app, provider and capture mode.
items.evidence: Helper exclusion works in bounded tests; app-painted arrows, carets and a Chrome residual remain.
items.next: Publish capability limits and requalification rules; defer visual replacement recipes.

groups.title: Source timing, coordinates and image fidelity

items.title: Verify the source journal against actual encoded packets
items.scope: Recorder-owned exact timing, geometry segments, held/dropped references and explicit gaps.
items.evidence: Multiple native, Chrome, Electron and preview passes matched muxed timestamps; journal closure is kept separate from video finalization.

items.title: Verify move, resize and cross-display geometry
items.scope: Authored marker transforms on built-in Retina, external 1× display with negative origin, and return.
items.evidence: Four encoded cross-display marker frames had zero edge error; all 8,315 corresponding timestamps matched.

items.title: Qualify input-to-video clocks beyond the native canaries
items.scope: Separate delivered-event, recorder-reception and frame clocks.
items.evidence: Native delivery timestamp/cross-display evidence is preserved. Bracketed host-clock boundaries, receipt segments and affected-take interruption now pass injected/live recording checks; raw provider clocks are not automatically equated to receipt or frame clocks.
items.next: Qualify remaining provider/physical-input clock semantics; preserve uncertainty and stop affected footage at observed discontinuities.

items.title: Qualify pointer positions for downstream composition
items.scope: Normalize provider positions into recorded pixels without guessing coordinate semantics.
items.evidence: Four native CUA delivered clicks exactly matched raw CG coordinates and event timestamps across external 1x and built-in 2x, including negative desktop y. Saved transforms predicted decoded marker centroids within 0.5 pixels. One take supplied 481 exact source/mux samples. Initial noWindowsAvailable refusal retained; external/home AX controls recovered delivery without restarting the take.
items.next: Qualify drag/scroll and another provider or physical-input lane, then expose recorder-owned mapping with explicit provider confidence; do not repeat settled native-click proof.

items.title: Verify sleep, wake and display-transition policy
items.scope: Service-owned bracketed clock observations, explicit uncertain intervals and affected-only take interruption. Physical sleep/wake remains unqualified.
items.evidence: 26 checks and 100 awake samples passed; 125 journal-bound checks passed. Live awake take/MCP: 81 exact timestamps, nine anchors, no lost rows. Ten arming-state checks preserved peers/admission. Injected gap in real capture: 33 exact samples, one gap, partial finalization and no held-at-end fill.
items.next: Qualify physical sleep/wake when it can be isolated safely; retain threshold, source-coverage and provider-clock uncertainty. Do not repeat injected or awake canaries without a changed boundary.

items.title: Qualify capture color fidelity
items.scope: Candidate SDR observed color tags and declared-sRGB source-to-preview references across both displays; inherited app backing behavior is preserved, while arbitrary backing intent, HDR, physical colorimetry and viewer transfer accuracy remain unqualified.
items.evidence: Eight cold BGRA/NV12 probes isolated the pre-encoder backing-color boundary. Explicit 709 and CI sRGB did not repair inherited values; changing only the owned fixture backing restored raw references within 1 channel value. Signed/loaded ff2c43b308aa passed 10 tag checks, 229 exact muxed timestamps and 18 reference samples within 2 across three geometry segments; 230-frame software preview matched all 18 exactly. Actual MCP returned observed tags. Earlier failure and limits retained; no global color correction or other app/settings mutation.

items.title: Qualify dense pointer, keyboard and gesture telemetry
items.scope: Delivered keys, modifiers, motion, clicks, scroll and drag with bounded callback work.
items.evidence: Native keyboard and gesture signals were retained with zero overflow in bounded takes.
items.next: Test high-rate overload and other providers; keep raw trajectories and loss counts explicit.

items.title: Separate session events from unrelated user activity
items.scope: Retain delivery and action-context reasons, broad shortcuts and uncertain candidates.
items.evidence: 36 native delivered events matched without target foreground; 40 unrelated key events were excluded after the action block ended.
items.next: Test concurrent user/agent activity in the same app and more global-shortcut cases; do not infer ownership from focus.

items.title: Verify protected-input omission and recovery
items.scope: Explicit Carbon protected-input fixture with the tested provider.
items.evidence: All 24 delivered protected events were omitted with enabled/ended gaps; six normal events recovered. A secure field alone did not enable protection.

items.title: Verify service-stamped action blocks and uncertain recovery
items.scope: Bounded contextual scopes, caller/session checks, expiry, restart recovery and no replay.
items.evidence: Restart kept an unknown end time; wrappers ran once; a late close correctly stayed expired.

items.title: Connect rich semantic blocks to capture milestones
items.scope: Intent, before/after context and verification evidence for later precise cues.
items.evidence: Recorder-stamped declared action blocks, marks and shared imported receipts have source evidence.
items.next: Expand milestone coverage and supported-provider integration without inventing missing events.

items.title: Qualify missing-event and tap-fault behavior
items.scope: Expose virtual-input gaps, revoked access, disabled taps and overload.
items.evidence: Owned passive listener: 27 policy checks; three controlled timeout recoveries then exhaustion; user-disable overrides and blocks a second subscriber. Eight exact native key transitions proved four omitted and four retained after deliberate recreation. Source summaries retain negative faults. A 750-ms passive delay produced no natural timeout.
items.next: Qualify physical access revocation and natural timeout when safely observable; extend virtual-provider coverage. Initial CG/per-key/recovery calls remain unbounded; do not infer completeness from listening status.

items.title: Verify startup deadlines and retained admission
items.scope: Bounded caller waits, unfinished producer quarantine, cancellation and late results.
items.evidence: 50 deadline and 12 recording-state assertions passed; live unavailable targets and isolated SDK recovery were qualified.

items.title: Move periodic context work away from capture and input loops
items.scope: Shared background slots, stale snapshots, late-generation rejection and lifecycle cleanup.
items.evidence: 113 listener, 106 recording-monitor and 113 window-context checks passed; the later 22-second live canary completed with 639 exact source timestamps.

items.title: Preserve and diagnose interrupted footage
items.scope: Separate journal completeness, writer outcome and actual decodable coverage.
items.evidence: Actual desktop failures exposed packet/submission differences; recovery preserved uncertainty and playable partial footage.

items.title: Verify controlled encoder deadline isolation and late return
items.scope: Candidate actual AVAssetWriter with authored off-screen frames, controlled blocked finalization, independent muxed clocks and retained manager admission. Does not include natural hardware/SDK hangs or installation.
items.evidence: 26 controlled checks and 15 exact independently decoded packet timestamps passed. Healthy peer finalized; failed journal closed while blocked; callback/call return both required; late completion preserved the interrupted outcome. Signed private service capability readback and cleanup passed. Final proof also covers early watchdog arming and empty-writer late cancellation.

items.title: Verify stream-stop deadlines, errors and late acknowledgment
items.scope: Controlled stop operations through actual recording/admission/persistence plus one tiny live successful acknowledgment. Does not include natural faults, backend physical release or production installation.
items.evidence: 25 controlled checks passed. Signed private 2c8da26d3792 finalized a passive canary, matched two muxed timestamps and released the acknowledged stop reservation. Returned errors remain reserved; timeout never retries. Private process exited.

items.title: Verify remaining encoder/OS failure paths without harming peer takes
items.scope: Avoid widening a local failure into an unexpected service interruption.
items.evidence: Signed private 88ce9b196ca6 removes whole-engine restart; 26 actual off-screen writer/recording/admission checks plus 27 adjacent state checks passed. Healthy peer and late-return safety verified; natural hardware/initial OS faults remain open. Sixteenth pass adds 25 controlled stream-stop lifecycle/recording/admission checks and an actual successful SDK acknowledgment; deadlines/errors retain explicit reservations without retries.
items.next: Prepare guarded idle maintenance/delivery; retain natural SDK/hardware and initial-call limits, then verify installed behavior.

items.title: Verify single-source moving footage
items.scope: Authored point-resolution 30-fps and Retina 60-fps motion takes.
items.evidence: 721 and 1,384 packet timestamps matched; decoded counters changed 719 and 1,337 times.

items.title: Qualify motion insurance with matching backup coverage
items.scope: A paired source must preserve the same changing scene and prove usable recovery.
items.evidence: The paired take failed: 713 muxed packets versus 715 submissions, timing mismatch and constant counter; display backup scene coverage was not established.
items.next: Correct the test preconditions and repeat under measured host health; prove actual shot recovery before recommending redundancy.

items.title: Set a realistic resource and admission budget
items.scope: CPU, memory, encoder/GPU/storage costs and useful production-duration estimates.
items.evidence: Single-source costs and offline overlap admission were measured; they do not establish safe real-world paired capacity or P80 duration. Fifteenth pass reserves unfinished startup, encoder calls/callbacks and unconfirmed stream stops even after terminal state or requested end; late completion releases admission. Configured cap is explicitly not capacity.
items.next: Qualify synchronized insurance under measured health and finalize conservative resource recommendations; natural SDK/hardware saturation is not established.

items.title: Bound export/probe subprocesses and recover admission
items.scope: One owned child, concurrent pipe drains, output bounds, deadlines and quarantine until actual exit.
items.evidence: 88 actual-child checks passed, including TERM resistance, forced exit and subsequent recovery.

items.title: Provide draft, standard and full preview effort
items.scope: Configurable width, frame rate and software/hardware backend for short source previews.
items.evidence: Real draft, standard and GIF previews had 145 mapped frames each; full/native/60-fps added 725 references.

items.title: Keep preview timing and parent-frame mapping inside the service
items.scope: Exact rational clocks, non-grid trims, GIF quantization, held frames and pixel transforms.
items.evidence: Final authored repeat matched 139 decoded frames; real source/time-map readbacks passed, including a seven-packet 0.07–0.14-second boundary.

items.title: Correct the authored GIF palette regression
items.scope: The tested gray-color fixture and bounded export pipeline.
items.evidence: The differential palette lost the final fixture color; full histograms preserved it. Failed output was retained.

items.title: Verify immutable export names and uncertain-parent provenance
items.scope: Unique defaults, explicit overwrite refusal and preservation of source quality.
items.evidence: Two default requests produced distinct names; the interrupted 12-frame preview retained uncertain parent quality.

items.title: Reject unsupported capture/export contracts
items.scope: Same-connection capability checks and explicit refusals before dispatch.
items.evidence: Node regressions passed old-engine refusal, explicit option forwarding, exact time maps and no export replay after socket loss.

groups.title: Shared computer-use learning and workflow quality

items.title: Centralize version-scoped app observations
items.scope: Shared reported facts, exact environment keys, expiry and conflicting evidence.
items.evidence: Shared versioned observation store, conflicts/expiry and scoped Chrome facts passed earlier. A new unresolved Chrome native-select readiness case was stored and independently read back with exact entity/value/ID; unknown backend version/result stay unknown, with one-day expiry.
items.next: Reconcile actual consumer use and feed non-recording workflows into the shared fact store; never promote unknown environmental observations into success guarantees.

items.title: Build maintained app lanes and breadth-first requalification
items.scope: Baseline ingestion for stable daily apps and updates when app/provider/OS behavior changes.
items.evidence: Native, Chrome and Electron lanes have scoped evidence; requalification still depends on explicit test runs.
items.next: Add ingestion, expiry/update triggers and recurring evidence reinforcement without claiming automatic model training.

items.title: Verify the quality of recent shared computer-use workflows
items.scope: Assess delivered actions, verification and cleanup rather than tool-call counts.
items.evidence: Structural audit covered 31 chats and 2,655 matching call/results; observation references do not establish successful tasks.
items.next: Use structured outcomes for a trustworthy quality audit and smoke-test the shared workflow after refactors.

items.title: Improve automatic receipt coverage across providers
items.scope: Capture durable operation evidence for native and browser actions.
items.evidence: An explicit callback wrapper and imported shared receipts work; native CUA still requires deliberate bracketing.
items.next: Integrate typed delivery/verification/cleanup outcomes where supported; keep uncovered operations explicit.

items.title: Finalize production modes and interruption expectations
items.scope: Clear background/cooperative/reserved-window expectations with input available and recovery choices.
items.evidence: Agreed production intervals, pause boundaries and owned-only cleanup were used; no input lock was added.
items.next: Publish tested mode capabilities and estimates; reserve disruptive work only through clear user alignment.

items.title: Install the candidate safely and verify rollback
items.scope: Idle-boundary release with prior binary/state preserved and exact loaded-capability readback.
items.evidence: Read-only inventory observed unchanged production idle and matching signatures. Legacy diagnostics remain unknown and admission is unfenced; no backup, install or restart occurred.
items.next: Prepare idle admission fencing, preserved bundle/state artifacts and guarded delivery; verify loaded build, source consumers and recovery afterward.

items.title: Smoke-test real capture and consumers after installation
items.scope: Verify delivered behavior on the installed service, not only isolated builds.
items.evidence: No candidate installation has occurred; these checks are intentionally still pending.
items.next: Verify installed capture, source/time-map consumers, recovery and cleanup after release.

items.title: Finish agent usage and recovery runbooks
items.scope: Capabilities, gaps, deadlines, semantic blocks, app facts, effort and collision/recovery guidance.
items.evidence: Source contracts, a readiness report and repeatable qualification kit exist; final reconciliation is pending. Candidate failure-isolation, retained admission and idle maintenance expectations are now documented.
items.next: Reconcile instructions with delivered behavior and publish limits, fallback and cleanup expectations.

items.title: Build cursor styles, effects and final compositing recipes
items.scope: Custom cursor series, visual/audio cues, overlays, frames and composition strategy.
items.evidence: Taylor explicitly moved visual composition to the next phase; cursor.svg is a test asset only.
items.next: Revisit after capture foundations and production expectations are qualified.
